newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Indonesia May vehicle sales said 38,242 units.
newsitem.headline: Indonesia May vehicle sales said 38,242 units.

text.p: Indonesia's total vehicle sales in May were 38,242 units, compared with 35,411 units in April, according to a report made available to securities companies by PT Astra International.
A total of 26,964 vehicles were sold in May last year.
In the monthly statistical report obtained by Reuters on Monday, Astra said passenger car sales rose to 5,649 units in May from 5,468 units in April, compared with 2,817 units in May last year.
It said sales of Indonesia's controversial Timor "national" car were 1,296 compared to 1,621 in April.
The Timor car is produced by South Korea's Kia Motors Corp in association with PT Timor Putra Nasional, controlled by President Suharto's youngest son Hutomo Mandala Putra.
The report showed the Timor car had the highest sales of sedans in Indonesia in May. The government early this month ordered state organisations to buy Timors.
Japan, the European Union and the United States has taken Indonesia to the World Trade Organisation (WTO) over tax and tariff breaks the government has given to the Timor car project.
The Astra report said domestic commercial vehicle sales increased to 31,728 units in May from 29,506 units in April, compared with 23,628 units in May last year.
A total of 865 commercial vehicles were exported in May.
Astra said Indonesian motorcycle sales amounted to 160,117 units in May, against 159,291 units in April and compared with 113,924 units in May last year.
Astra, the agent for Japan's Honda motorcycles, had a market share of 48.78 percent in May against 48.68 percent in April, compared with 50.23 percent in May 1996.
